This directory contains the MIT-licensed native WebRTC transport from rust-libp2p 0.10.0-alpha. The source files retain the upstream license notices. The local changes support the pinned Go host’s v1 and v2 ICE credentials on inbound connections, including the separate client password used by browsers. The candidate policy enables a loopback ICE candidate for loopback peers and restricts the single-candidate workaround to the matching address class. This supports private and same-host DA peers without gathering a loopback candidate for a remote peer.

[Upstream source](https://github.com/libp2p/rust-libp2p/tree/7171dce2f90c05ba7892d4ba926abb1881db27c7/transports/webrtc)
